items.title: IREN Rallies 6% as Microsoft Signs Off on Horizon 1, NVIDIA Grants Exemplar Cloud Status
items.summary: Microsoft just signed off on IREN's first major AI data center, and NVIDIA piled on with a rare technical designation, sending shares surging. But with $5.8 billion in GPU purchases still ahead and a short seller circling, the real question is whether this milestone marks a turning point or just the beginning of the risk.
